findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

The mop sink by the back receiving door is still observed with several flies in the vicinity. The other areas noted on the previous routine inspection appear CORRECTED at this time, but this area remains. The PICs were shown. EcoLab was on site at the time of this inspection conducting maintenance for the treated areas. He stated that he would order a spray for the facility to use on the areas surrounding the sink. He also suggested cycling the damaged sodas and other sugary drinks more often to remove a food source. Ensure that all pests are removed from the facility and the facility is maintained free of pests moving forward. Another follow up is being scheduled for 10 days to ensure compliance.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

The spray bottle in the meat room would not produce a color change on the inspector’s test strips. Investigation showed that the dispensing machine was not dispensing at correct concentration. The bottle was refilled from a different machine in the facility to correct the immediate violation. A check of the machine will be conducted on the scheduled follow up in ten days related to flies in the facility (refer to line item #38).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple knives in the produce prep area are observed with remaining food debris on them and in storage in the knife rack. Per the PICs these knives are damaged (observed chipped) and are being discarded during this inspection to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are thoroughly cleaned and sanitized prior to storage in the facility.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Multiple locations in the facility are observed with gnats/fruit flies/drain flies. Locations include: 1) the dairy mop sink; 2) the trash can in the produce area; 3) the mop sink by the back receiving door. The PICs were shown and instructed to contact pest control for maintenance. Ensure that all pests are removed from the facility and the facility is maintained free of pests moving forward.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment:
(REEPAT) 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

Multiple partially consumed drinks are observed throughout the stock areas of the facility. The PICs were shown and discarded the items during this inspection to correct. Ensure that employee foods are only consumed in areas that do not allow for possible food contamination.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

Two separate hand sinks in the facility are observed blocked during this inspection. One is in the produce walk-in area and the other is next to the meat department’s walk-in. The PIC was consulted and instructed to ensure that all hand sinks are easily accessible and available for use at all times. The carts were moved during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-102.11: Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. 

Containers of frosting are being reused as sani buckets in the bakery. This is acceptable, but the containers were not labeled as sanitizers during this inspection. The items were discussed with the PIC and labels added to the containers to correct. Ensure that containers of chemicals, this includes sanitizers, have labels indicating what is currently being housed in them.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

Multiple flies, gnats, are observed in the room outside of the produce walk in cooler. They appear to be centered around a containers of bananas that have gone bad. The container was discarded during this inspection. A follow up is being set for 10 days to ensure that the flies are no longer a concern in the facility.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-403.11: (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use tobacco shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. 

Multiple cans and cups are observed throughout the back-stock areas of the facility. These containers are opened and partially, or fully, consumed and are observed on containers of food. The PIC was shown and removed the items observed to correct the immediate violation. Foods should not be consumed in areas where foods intended for sale are being stored. It is highly suggested that all foods are consumed in the break room or other similar areas so as not to pose a concern for contaminating foods intended for sale.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.  

The dish machine in the bakery area is in need of repair/ adjustment to be in compliance. The follow up will be conducted in two weeks to ensure repairs/adjustment have been made.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

Two separate hand sinks in the facility are observed blocked during this inspection. One is along the back wall of the bakery and the other is next to the meat department’s walk-in. Both hand sinks had carts in front of them. The PIC was consulted and instructed to ensure that all hand sinks are easily accessible and available for use at all times. The carts were moved during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. 

The hand sink in the produce preparation area is observed without soap during this inspection. The soap was replaced during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-703.11: After cleaning, FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be SANITIZED in: (A) manual hot water operations. (B) mechanical hot water operations. (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA-registered label use  standard contact time 30 seconds. 

The dish machine in the bakery area is not reaching critical temperature of 160F at the surface of the dishes. As a temporary measure the machine will be used for the wash and rinse steps and the three part sink will be used for sanitizing. A follow up will be issued under line item #1 for two weeks to ensure that the dish machine is functioning correctly.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.13: (A) In manual WAREWASHING operations, a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be provided and readily accessible for frequently measuring the washing and SANITIZING temperatures. (B) In hot water mechanical WAREWASHING operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the UTENSIL surface temperature. 

A method to ensure that the temperature sanitizing dish machine in the bakery area was reaching critical temperature was not available during this inspection. A follow up will be conducted in two weeks for compliance.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The coving to the right of the mop sink in the bakery area has a gap between sections approximating 1-2 inches. The space should be smooth and easily cleanable without any gaps or spaces. Repair prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.113: Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools. 

Mops in the mop sink adjacent to the dairy walk in cooler are stored pooled in the mop bucket and sink. The PIC was consulted and instructed to stored mops in a way that allows for drip drying. Ensure that this is reviewed with employees and they store these items correctly.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

The mop sink in the produce prep area has a thick accumulation of debris left sitting in it. The debris appears to be produce litter and ground dirt. The area is also still moist. Ensure that proper cleaning takes place so that debris is not accumulated.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee observed donning gloves and packaging donuts without washing hands first. CORRECTED— Discussed with PIC. Provided education. Hands must be washed upon entering the kitchen before beginning food handling and before donning gloves. Review handwashing procedures with staff.
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  [P]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
No irreversible registering temperature indicator present to verify dish machine rinse temperature. 
4-302.13: (A) In manual WAREWASHING operations, a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be provided and readily accessible for frequently measuring the washing and SANITIZING temperatures. (B) In hot water mechanical WAREWASHING operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the UTENSIL surface temperature. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Coving is damaged in the bakery near the dish machine/mop corner. Repair coving so that wall/floor junction is smooth and easily cleanable.
6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED. [C]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: Observed two handsinks without paper towels. Manager called for dispensers to be refilled and employee refilled dispensers before completion of the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with (A) Individual, disposable towels. (Pf)
